يقتحمون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَحِمُونَ (yaqtaḥimūna) /jaq.ta.ħi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# يُقْتَحَمُونَ (yuqtaḥamūna) /juq.ta.ħa.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
